provider: Harvard Dataverse Repository - per-collection quota (the multiplier, not the 1 TB headline)

free_tier.stated: 1 TB per Dataverse Collection allocation (2.5 TB for Harvard affiliates). Per-file 2.5 GB through UI/API; larger via the S3 direct-upload path. The 1 TB is enforced as a *collection* allocation, not a per-person cap: GET /api/dataverses/<alias>/storage/quota?showInherited=true returns {"Total quota allocation for this collection": 1099511627776} for ordinary collections, and one live collection returns 2748779069440 (2.5 TB).

retention.stated: | write-once: publishing is irreversible, no delete without support intervention, no embargo; 'Submit for Review' spam screen before publication; per-file 2.5 GB in the browser path; 1,000 files/dataset is the observed effectiveDatasetFileCountLimit; S3 direct upload is admin-enabled per install and is the only route past the 2.5 GB file cap.

egress.terms: Free, anonymous, no login: GET /api/access/datafile/<id> returns 303 to a signed dvn-cloud-iqss S3 URL (X-Amz-Expires=3600), which serves 200 with Content-Length and honours Range (206 + Content-Range).

tooling: REST native API (create dataset, add files, direct S3 upload), plus the official Python/CLI clients. dataset count 306,027 live. rclone has no native backend but the S3 direct-upload path accepts any S3 client.
chaining: #207 comment 2024-07-24: 'Anyone can create collections in Harvard Dataverse now, as of sometime in June 2024'. N collections = N x 1 TiB allocations. Sibling collections can also be nested, so a 'Dataverse Collection' tree is the natural shard key.
limits_note: write-once: publishing is irreversible, no delete without support intervention, no embargo; 'Submit for Review' spam screen before publication; per-file 2.5 GB in the browser path; 1,000 files/dataset is the observed effectiveDatasetFileCountLimit; S3 direct upload is admin-enabled per install and is the only route past the 2.5 GB file cap.
reliability_note: Anonymous read is a 1-hour signed S3 redirect, so re-resolve per request (rule 8); quota API is rate-limited and starts returning 403 after a short burst of collection probes.
